description: Held-out questions over the Rentals fixture, an invented equipment-rental company (SQLite, built from dev_tools/fixtures/sql/rentals.sql; the same file loads into PostgreSQL). Written and frozen before any measurement and never run through the engine: do not edit a case after seeing a result. The data and the answers were written by the same author and have not been reviewed by anyone else. Gold SQL is the source of truth; `expected` rows are a snapshot of it (python -m dev_tools.evals snapshot --dsn sqlite:///...). Rentals start 2024-01-08..2025-06-25; maintenance jobs are dated 2024-01-15..2025-06-05.

cases.question: How many branches do we have?
cases.description: One branch has a closing date. Either every branch on record or only the branches still open is accepted.

gold.label: all_branches
gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM branch

gold.label: open_branches
gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM branch WHERE closed_on IS NULL

cases.question: How many customers do we have?
cases.description: Customers whose record is soft-deleted (deleted_at filled) are not customers any more.

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

cases.question: How many of our customers are businesses rather than private individuals?
cases.description: Private individuals have no company name. Soft-deleted customers are excluded.

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer WHERE co_name IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

cases.question: How many pieces of equipment do we have in each category?
cases.description: One row per category. Units whose record is soft-deleted are not counted; units retired from service still are (they are still owned records).

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT ec.cat_nm, COUNT(*) AS units FROM equip_category ec JOIN equip_unit u ON u.cat_id = ec.cat_id WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY ec.cat_id, ec.cat_nm

cases.question: How many rentals were cancelled?
cases.description: The status is stored as a one-letter code; the lookup table gives its meaning. Soft-deleted rentals are excluded.

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rental r JOIN rental_status s ON s.stat_cd = r.stat_cd WHERE s.stat_cd = 'X' AND r.deleted_at IS NULL

cases.question: How many rentals are currently out with customers?
cases.description: Currently out means the rental status is Active (the equipment has not been returned yet).

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rental r JOIN rental_status s ON s.stat_cd = r.stat_cd WHERE s.stat_cd = 'A' AND r.deleted_at IS NULL

cases.question: How many rentals has each branch completed?
cases.description: Completed means status Closed (returned and settled). The branch is the one that handled the rental. Soft-deleted rentals are excluded.

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT b.br_name, COUNT(*) AS completed FROM branch b JOIN rental r ON r.branch_id = b.branch_id JOIN rental_status s ON s.stat_cd = r.stat_cd WHERE s.stat_cd = 'C' AND r.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY b.branch_id, b.br_name

cases.question: Which customer has rented from us the most times?
cases.description: The customer and the number of rentals. A cancelled booking may or may not be counted as a rental, so both readings are accepted (the top customer is the same, the count differs by one). Soft-deleted rentals never count. No tie in either reading (10 against 9, 11 against 9). Extra columns such as the contact or the reference are accepted.

gold.label: excluding_cancelled
gold.sql: SELECT c.co_name, COUNT(*) AS rentals FROM customer c JOIN rental r ON r.cust_id = c.cust_id JOIN rental_status s ON s.stat_cd = r.stat_cd WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.stat_cd <> 'X' GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.co_name ORDER BY rentals DESC LIMIT 1

gold.label: including_cancelled
gold.sql: SELECT c.co_name, COUNT(*) AS rentals FROM customer c JOIN rental r ON r.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.co_name ORDER BY rentals DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Which 3 pieces of equipment have brought in the most rental money?
cases.description: Each unit is identified by its serial number and ranked by the sum of its rental line amounts, leaving out soft-deleted rentals. Extra descriptive columns (model) are accepted. No tie at the cut-off.

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT u.serial_no, SUM(ri.line_amt) AS income FROM equip_unit u JOIN rental_item ri ON ri.unit_id = u.unit_id JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = ri.rental_id WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY u.unit_id, u.serial_no ORDER BY income DESC LIMIT 3

cases.question: Which equipment category earns us the most from rentals?
cases.description: The category and the sum of rental line amounts of its units, leaving out soft-deleted rentals. No tie.

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT ec.cat_nm, SUM(ri.line_amt) AS income FROM equip_category ec JOIN equip_unit u ON u.cat_id = ec.cat_id JOIN rental_item ri ON ri.unit_id = u.unit_id JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = ri.rental_id WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY ec.cat_id, ec.cat_nm ORDER BY income DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: How many rentals were returned late?
cases.description: Late means the actual return date is after the agreed return date (due date). Rentals not yet returned have no return date and are not late. Soft-deleted rentals are excluded.

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rental WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND ret_dt > due_dt

cases.question: What percentage of finished rentals came back late?
cases.description: Finished means status Closed. Share of those whose return date is after the due date, over all closed rentals that are not soft-deleted. Either the percentage or the fraction is accepted.

gold.label: percent
gold.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ret_dt > due_dt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) FROM rental WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND stat_cd = 'C'

gold.label: fraction
gold.sql: SELECT ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ret_dt > due_dt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 4) FROM rental WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND stat_cd = 'C'

cases.question: What is the customer reference of Orchard Lane Builders?
cases.description: The reference is stored in the abbreviated column cust_ref.

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT cust_ref FROM customer WHERE co_name = 'Orchard Lane Builders'

cases.question: How many maintenance jobs did we carry out in 2024?
cases.description: The job date is stored as text in the form DD/MM/YYYY.

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM maint_job WHERE SUBSTR(job_dt, 7, 4) = '2024'

cases.question: How much did we spend on maintenance between 1 March and 31 May 2025, both days included?
cases.description: The job date is text in the form DD/MM/YYYY. Jobs with no cost (covered by warranty) are empty and add nothing.

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT SUM(cost) FROM maint_job WHERE SUBSTR(job_dt, 7, 4) || SUBSTR(job_dt, 4, 2) || SUBSTR(job_dt, 1, 2) BETWEEN '20250301' AND '20250531'

cases.question: How many maintenance jobs has each technician done?
cases.description: One row per technician with the number of jobs. A technician who has since left (soft-deleted staff record) still did the jobs, so is included.

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT s.full_nm, COUNT(*) AS jobs FROM staff s JOIN maint_job m ON m.tech_id = s.staff_id GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.full_nm

cases.question: How many rentals included more than one piece of equipment?
cases.description: Equipment is linked to rentals through the rental item table. Soft-deleted rentals are excluded; cancelled bookings may or may not count as rentals, so both counts are accepted.

gold.label: excluding_cancelled
gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT ri.rental_id FROM rental_item ri JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = ri.rental_id WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.stat_cd <> 'X' GROUP BY ri.rental_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) t

gold.label: including_cancelled
gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT ri.rental_id FROM rental_item ri JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = ri.rental_id WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY ri.rental_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) t

cases.question: Which equipment has Cinder Road Motors rented?
cases.description: The units rented, through customer, rental, rental item and equipment unit (four tables). Soft-deleted and cancelled rentals are left out. Listing the serial numbers with the models, or just the distinct models, is accepted.

gold.label: serial_and_model
gold.sql: SELECT DISTINCT u.serial_no, u.model_nm FROM customer c JOIN rental r ON r.cust_id = c.cust_id JOIN rental_item ri ON ri.rental_id = r.rental_id JOIN equip_unit u ON u.unit_id = ri.unit_id WHERE c.co_name = 'Cinder Road Motors' AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.stat_cd <> 'X'

gold.label: model_only
gold.sql: SELECT DISTINCT u.model_nm FROM customer c JOIN rental r ON r.cust_id = c.cust_id JOIN rental_item ri ON ri.rental_id = r.rental_id JOIN equip_unit u ON u.unit_id = ri.unit_id WHERE c.co_name = 'Cinder Road Motors' AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.stat_cd <> 'X'

cases.question: How many pieces of equipment have never been rented out?
cases.description: Units whose record is soft-deleted are not counted. Rentals that are soft-deleted or cancelled do not count as a rental of the unit (every reading gives the same number here).

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM equip_unit u WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rental_item ri JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = ri.rental_id WHERE ri.unit_id = u.unit_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.stat_cd <> 'X')

cases.question: How many invoices are still waiting to be paid?
cases.description: Waiting to be paid means open (not yet paid in full). Void invoices are not waiting for payment.
cases.evidence: Invoice payment status codes (pay_stat): P = paid in full, O = open (not yet paid in full), V = void (cancelled, never collected).

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoice WHERE pay_stat = 'O'

cases.question: How much money do customers still owe us on open invoices?
cases.description: Owed = total of the open invoices minus the live payments received against them.
cases.evidence: Invoice payment status codes (pay_stat): P = paid in full, O = open (not yet paid in full), V = void (cancelled, never collected). The amount still owed on open invoices is the invoice totals (inv_ttl) minus the payments received against them. Payment rows with deleted_at filled were reversed entries and are not money received.

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.inv_ttl) - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.amt), 0) FROM payment p JOIN invoice i2 ON i2.inv_id = p.inv_id WHERE i2.pay_stat = 'O' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL), 2) FROM invoice i WHERE i.pay_stat = 'O'

cases.question: What was our net rental revenue in 2025?
cases.description: Net revenue is the sum of invoice subtotals (before tax) of non-void invoices, by invoice date.
cases.evidence: Invoice payment status codes (pay_stat): P = paid in full, O = open (not yet paid in full), V = void (cancelled, never collected). Net rental revenue is the sum of invoice subtotals before tax (inv_sub), leaving out void invoices, for invoices dated in the period.

gold.label: primary
gold.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(inv_sub), 2) FROM invoice WHERE pay_stat <> 'V' AND inv_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND inv_dt < '2026-01-01'

cases.question: How much have we received through each payment method?
cases.description: Payments with deleted_at filled are reversed entries and are excluded. The methods may be shown by code or by decoded name.
cases.evidence: Payment method codes (method_cd): CC = credit card, BT = bank transfer, CH = cheque. Payments marked as deleted were reversed entries and are not money received.

gold.label: by_code
gold.sql: SELECT method_cd, ROUND(SUM(amt), 2) FROM payment WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY method_cd

gold.label: by_label
gold.sql: SELECT CASE method_cd WHEN 'CC' THEN 'credit card' WHEN 'BT' THEN 'bank transfer' WHEN 'CH' THEN 'cheque' END, ROUND(SUM(amt), 2) FROM payment WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY method_cd

cases.question: What is the average credit limit we give our customers?
cases.description: Customers with no credit limit (empty) pay up front. Either the average over customers who have a limit, or over all customers counting no limit as zero, is accepted. Soft-deleted customers are excluded.

gold.label: customers_with_limit
gold.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(credit_lmt), 2) FROM customer WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

gold.label: all_customers_zero
gold.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(credit_lmt, 0)) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 2) FROM customer WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
